name: Spencer H.
text: Eduardo at Big Bear provided a great service to my Chevy box truck. Upon taking the wheels off to do the requested brake job, he noticed that the original requested service was not required, and provided an honest recommendation of what to do next. Fixed the root cause of my issue without unnecessary extras. Great honest guy.

name: Veronica Ceja
text: Shout out to Eduardo for his hard work. Fixed my truck with an oil change had me out again soon. Totally take that man on his word. Very knowledgeable on what he is doing. Fair pricing for him coming all the way to where I broke down. If I had to pay a tow it would've doubled easily. Recommend him if you are anywhere near southwest Michigan.

name: D B
text: Amazing service !!! Had coolant leak on trans cooler for Volvo VNL 860 . Completed repairs quickly for great price and great service . Only mechanic I would call or use in Grand Rapids area . Thank you again .

name: Rosie Bernal
text: My Truck got stranded turns out I needed a new Battery Eduardo came in less than 30 minutes!

name: Maria G
text: This was a road call and I am amazed by the professionalism & quality. Got my truck up and running in little to no time. Got left stranded? give them a call! You're in good hands.

name: Matthew Patrickson
text: Eduardo has been servicing my trucks for 2 years and let me tell you he's the best in the area. If you like honesty this is where it's at.

name: Rolando Almanza
text: One of the fastest and professional company I have to do business with.. Ask for Egguardo, the guy knows how to repair these trucks.

name: John B.
text: Keeps good maintance in my truck keeps me rolling

name: Rosie
text: Very good service & reasonable prices. Owner ALWAYS goes out of his way. Definitely recommend!
